# Summary list

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a summary list to present related key-and-value facts, optionally with contextual actions or a summary-card heading.

## When to use

- Use for facts that each have a clear key and at least one value.
- Use summary cards for several records of the same type, such as people or appointments.
- Add actions when users can change or remove the corresponding information.

## When not to use

- Do not use for tabular comparisons; use a Table.
- Do not use for an ordinary sequence or task list.
- Do not force content without a meaningful key-value relationship into a description list.

## Anatomy

- **Description list (required):** A govuk-summary-list dl contains repeated row wrappers.
- **Key and value (required):** Each row contains a dt key and dd value.
- **Actions:** An optional dd contains links with visually hidden row context.
- **Card heading:** A summary card can group a list with a heading and whole-card actions.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Summary list | `dl` | `govuk-summary-list` | One group of key-value facts. |
| Without borders | `dl` | `govuk-summary-list`, `govuk-summary-list--no-border` | A short simple list where row borders add unnecessary visual weight. |
| Summary card | `div` | `govuk-summary-card` | One of several comparable records requiring its own heading or actions. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- No GOV.UK JavaScript module is required and action links use ordinary href navigation.
- Keep rows in a meaningful order and retain the semantic dl, dt and dd elements.
- After a change action, return users to the correct review context where possible.

## Accessibility contract

- Add visually hidden key context to repeated action labels, for example “Change name”.
- Set the card heading level to fit the page hierarchy.
- Do not create empty keys or values merely to preserve a visual grid.

## Content rules

- Keep keys concise and use the same terms as the questions that collected the data.
- Format values for reading rather than exposing raw storage values.
- Use consistent action verbs such as “Change” and “Remove”.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.border`
- `govuk.color.link`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.typography.weight.bold`

## HTML examples

### Facts with contextual action

```html
<dl class="govuk-summary-list">
  <div class="govuk-summary-list__row">
    <dt class="govuk-summary-list__key">Name</dt>
    <dd class="govuk-summary-list__value">Alex Smith</dd>
    <dd class="govuk-summary-list__actions"><a class="govuk-link" href="/name">Change<span class="govuk-visually-hidden"> name</span></a></dd>
  </div>
</dl>
```
